主要内容: The 2014 Subaru BRZ (* models manufactured after December 2013) has been awarded an IIHS 2014 TOP SAFETY PICK. The model achieved a 'good' status in the Institute's crashworthiness evaluations of front moderate overlap, side impact, roof crush, and rear impact. It received an 'acceptable' rating in the front small overlap test, marking the first time the IIHS has rated the BRZ in this test since its launch in 2012. Subaru now has seven models that have earned 2014 safety awards from IIHS, including the BRZ. The BRZ is powered by a 200-horsepower BOXER engine and is priced at $25,595. It is also offered as a special edition called Series.Blue for 2015. The award highlights Subaru's commitment to safety and quality in its vehicles.
